summary: pause options: echo for keyboard input visibility, minutes, prompt text (input returned only without a time), and seconds.
questions: How do I hide typed input during a pause prompt?
How do I capture user input from pause?
How do I pause for 30 seconds?

answer_card.title: pause parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `seconds` / `minutes`: duration
- `prompt`: message; user input only returned when no duration
- `echo` (yes): show typed input (only without duration)
